notes.title: 0.750 Bug Fixes & Awakening Enhancements
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

You may be wondering where have we been all this time. We are a small team of a few members that work on this game. Over the past few years the project leads Mother had been very unwell, suffering a rapid decline in health. She has now passed on and will be missed greatly by the surviving members of her family. Of course in these situations family comes first, we hope everyone can understand that during an alpha stage in development.

With the Bad News out of the way we can give you the update news.

ANGLES v.0750 UPDATE:
[b]Bugs Fixed: [/b]
[list]
[*]Teleport East has now been fixed.
[*]Longitudinal navigation clamped.
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]
Awakening Mode Changes:
[list]
[*]Easy Mode = Infinite Stamina
[*]Normal = Infinite Health or Armor
[*]Hard = Infinite Armor only if Armor intact
[/list]
Awakening mode is charged through kills and activated with "4"

[b]Infinite World update:[/b]
[list]
[*] If you travel to world edges, you may travel in a direction.
[*] Going north will take you to mountains, then the dungeons.
[*] Going south will explore the forests, east/west is infinite biomes.
[/list]

The Good News is we now have the foundation of the Game in a solid working state.
Until we more bugs of course!

We have begun working on the final Graphical Overhaul for 1.0 release.
There will be some news on this in Future.

Thanks for sticking around, the wait will be worth it.

The Team,
BioPunk Games

notes.title: v0.64a Gamepad Support Added
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
We have added Controller Support for Gamepads. This can be selected in the pause menu or by starting a new game. Hybrid mode can be used by both Keyboard/Mouse and Gamepads. When Starting a new Game, Controller options have now replaced the Time Scale system. All Games now use the "365 days to a Year" Timescale. The Hybrid Control Scheme is a new system we are currently working on. 

Hybrid mode Draws an invisible Line from the Player to the Aiming Indicator on the Screen. If an enemy is on that line and inside the weapon range, you will hit it.
Multi-Hit is unaffected. Ranged Weapons now Spawn a Projectile when in Hybrid mode.


[b]Changes:[/b]
- Choose Hybrid from Pause screen or start a new game.
- All Menus now Support Gamepads, use L Stick up/down.
- New Aiming System uses Line Trace from Player to Cursor Position.
-- Any enemy in range on that Line will be Hit


[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Tree removed from middle of road


Thanks for Playing!

Tom
http://www.ShogunateGames.com

notes.title: v0.63b Captain Spawning System
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
This one is coming in early, Captains are now handled properly by it's own Spawning system. This tracks distance from the Enemy to the Player among other things. The Captain Spawns should be equally rare, however they cannot travel as far as before, without you being nearby. 

The Gobling Captains refused to Die with their King! This Change has solved this for good.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/a88764cf2993f79821e6abfe795a0f7e51396633.png[/img]


[b]Changes:[/b]
- Captains removed from all Maps
- Dedicated Spawning System now handling Captains
- Captains can roam twice as far from the player as Swarm type Enemies


[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Gobling Captains now Die with their King, As intended.
* Tree removed from middle of road


[b]DEMO PLAYERS: You will also be updated to this version.[/b]
Early Access Builds will begin to diverge as we go on, so this will always be stated in patch notes, should there be a Demo update rolled out.


Thanks for Playing!

Tom
http://www.ShogunateGames.com

notes.title: v0.62b Fishy Limits
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
Pro Fisherman have been earning their Fortunes without fighting the Hordes, so we are introducing Daily Limits. You may fish to your hearts content, however, the Fishermonger will only buy 30 fish per day. (Excess Caught Fish will Rot away each Day)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/81c20ce15ff44f76920a68108338aa19aa00139e.png[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Daily Fishing Cap introduced. 30 Fish per Day.
- Rotting Fish, Daily Caught Fish reduction.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Regen Values Truncated for Display
* Boss now updates Chapter on level Exit (boss Fights)
* Bounty Rank and Scalp counters now reset properly
* Awakening now Stops when Traveling between Maps
* Tree Stump Removed from Middle of Road.


Thanks for Playing!

Tom
http://www.ShogunateGames.com

notes.title: V061c Fishy Update
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
Following Feedback from players we have begun fleshing out the Fishing Job. Jobs are ways to earn Gold or XP in the Village. 
When you stand on the Platform by the Lake, Fish begin to appear. If you use the Pike, you may catch these fish. These Fish can be sold to the Fishmonger for Gold.

We have also added mouse-wheel weapon selection and the player Skill Level system in this update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/440212c1426c7f908ccbb71aaf130553b3e8b64a.png[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Caught Fish Counter now Displays while Fishing
- Fish Spawn interval reduced & Surface times increased
- Wise Old Man now Talks louder
- Reaching Village Map edges now Travels North, South, East & West
- Player Torchlight Colour Adjusted, now correct on snow at night
- Bonus Loot Sound effects no longer misleading
- Skill Point Upgrade now applies Full HP as expected.
- Shops Now display Regen Amounts adjusted by Skill Levels.
- Sleeping Stamina Regen is now affected by Stamina Skill Level.
- Skill Level is calculated from your Total Skill Points.
- Skill Level now Displayed in Church Menu, below your Name.
- Skill Level gives 50 % Bonus to Sleeping Stamina Regen;
--- at Lvl 10 on Easy Difficulty
--- at Lvl 20 on Normal Difficulty
--- at Lvl 30 on Hard Difficulty
- Mouse Wheel Control Method added for Fast Weapon Selection.


[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Various text and labeling now displaying correctly
* East / West Edge Triggers now correctly aligned on all maps
* Weird Villager Moved
* Treestump removed from Road


[b]DEMO PLAYERS: You will also be updated to this version.[/b]
Early Access Builds will begin to diverge as we go on, so this will always be stated in patch notes (where a Demo update is also rolled out).


Thanks for Playing!

Tom
http://www.ShogunateGames.com

notes.title: v0.61 World Building
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
With this update we are adding travel between maps.
Similarly to DND you can choose to Go North, South, East or West.
By reaching the Edge of a map & pushing E you will travel.
As New Biomes are introduced this will become more complex.
There is currently no coastline, so East/West Travel is infinite.
The Bounty Board is still used to leave the Village!
Travel between Biomes as you head North or South.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/c96e1c9c98ef39969a5ceceafcbafae95df2a027.jpg[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Long & Lat system introduced
- Map Edges now Transport you around the World
- Time No Longer Cycles on Leaving the Village.
- Time Cycles when Travelling, returning to the Village & Sleeping.
- 50 HP now Restored on Revival after being Defeated.
- Arrow Count Now Displays correctly in Fletcher menu.
- Stat point changes now gives 100% health as intended.
- Fish Hitbox is now Doubled, use the Pike to catch fish!
- Player Class Ability now labelled "Double Damage"
- Sound Effects now muted during loading screen.


[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Moved House and loot inside bounds on tutorial map.
* Fishmonger now displays "eat in" for Grilled Fish.
* Church Voice Samples, modulation fixed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/3a15487d1d8350de75252fcb4586bee1bf4b0648.png[/img]

Thanks for Playing!

Tom
http://www.ShogunateGames.com

notes.title: v0.61 World Building
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
With this update we are adding travel between maps.
Similarly to DND you can choose to Go North, South, East or West.
By reaching the Edge of a map & pushing E you will travel.
As New Biomes are introduced this will become more complex.
There is currently no coastline, so East/West Travel is infinite.
The Bounty Board is still used to leave the Village!
Travel between Biomes as you head North or South.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/c96e1c9c98ef39969a5ceceafcbafae95df2a027.jpg[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Long & Lat system introduced
- Map Edges now Transport you around the World
- Time No Longer Cycles on Leaving the Village.
- Time Cycles when Travelling, returning to the Village & Sleeping.
- 50 HP now Restored on Revival after being Defeated.
- Arrow Count Now Displays correctly in Fletcher menu.
- Stat point changes now gives 100% health as intended.
- Fish Hitbox is now Doubled, use the Pike to catch fish!
- Player Class Ability now labelled "Double Damage"
- Sound Effects now muted during loading screen.


[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Moved House and loot inside bounds on tutorial map.
* Fishmonger now displays "eat in" for Grilled Fish.
* Church Voice Samples, modulation fixed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/3a15487d1d8350de75252fcb4586bee1bf4b0648.png[/img]

Thanks for Playing!

Tom

notes.title: v0.60 Release! New Magic Ability
notes.content:
[b]New Feature:[/b]
Once a Boss is defeated, you may choose to unlock a new Armour Class.
These Classes unlock as you progress through the game at the Armory.
All Classes will have a unique Ability, activated with the Spacebar.
The Mana Dash, temporarily slows down time while increasing Max Speed, was the first Casting. Now we have the Second ready!

[b]Changes:[/b]
- First Unlockable Class's Ability is now ready for Early Access Players to use.
- When Activated, Attacks are imbued with Rune Energy and hit for [b]Double Damage.[/b]
- Time is Slowed for twice the Duration of the Dash Ability.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
* Scalp Count now being reset on New Game inside same Session.
* Church no longer displays option to Heal
(The Fishmonger or Salted Fish Items should be used to Heal HP)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/0762bd361c566825644794996e90e7dec7ec34ec.png[/img]


Thanks for Playing!

Tom
http://www.ShogunateGames.com

notes.title: v0.58a The Difficult Update
notes.content:
New Feature:
Expanded Difficulty Modes, We have enhanced the game by adding more effects to your Choice of Difficulty. All the Detail are Below!
You already were able to gain Starting Gold (found in your house) by choosing Normal or Easy modes.
This will offer increased challenge or a casual experience based on your Choice when playing a new game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/0ad71da3fe3749cc7132610d796c619a959ba06a.png[/img]

(Demo Players - an update has been pushed, keeping you up to date!)

Enemy Spawning:
At any given time you may be in range of up to 3 spawners when Exploring the adventure maps.
Difficulty now scales the amount of enemies, increasing in each chapter, as detailed below.

Awakened Mode: (special)
Every time you hit an Enemy your Awakened bar (yellow) charges up. When full you may activate this by pressing 4.
The Awakened Bar drains down over time, during the period you do not pay for Mana Casting (space bar).
When selecting Easy mode, Stamina is also free while you are in Awakened mode.


Hard Mode:
Hard mode gives no Starting money and boasts the highest amount of enemies in the game, scaling all the way to the end.
Enemies are also given Double Damage and Double HP, to offer the greatest Challenge to the Player.
The Chapter Level also raises Base Spawn Limits on top of these changes, as before.


Changes:
- Easy mode: 
          | Enemy Spawner Base Limit = 10 
	  | Free Mana & Stamina in Awakened mode
	  | Starting Gold = 2000
- Normal Mode:
          | Enemy Spawner Base Limit = 15
	  | Free Mana in Awakened mode
	  | Starting Gold = 1000
- Hard Mode: 
          | Enemy Spawner Base Limit = 20
	  | Free Mana in Awakened mode
	  | Starting Gold = Zero
	  | All Tier 1 Enemies = Double HP + Damage

Bonus XP option still available, unaffected by these changes.
		  
		  
Bugs Fixed:
* Scalp Counter now displays correct Scalp Goal in Bounty Menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/45f3f037d02cb745006817718a0b05a7d2eea2a2.png[/img]


NOTE: during Early Access we may ask you to delete your savegame to ensure smooth running of ANGLES.
Patches that cause savegame resets are unavoidable during this stage.
In order to benefit from recent additions and enhancements made, we recommend you delete your savedata this time.


Thanks for Playing!


Tom
Shogunate Games

notes.title: V0.57a Scalps
notes.content:
New Feature:
The Bounty Board offers 500 Gold for killing Tier 1 Enemies in the world.
You must kill the Target number of Enemies and hand the scalps in for reward.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/5ae417bfc76763483821a0c5acd4438fe757c225.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32147040/4e1012e086f916e0a2fe664778deca34a6289f22.png[/img][/url]

Once handed in the number of scalps required for payment will be increased, 
but this resets back to 100 once the boss is defeated.

Changes:
- Splash Damage for Sword and Pike reduced by 1/3
- reduced Captain Special Charge Gains by 200%.
- Stuck Villager is now Free
- Treestump removed from Road
- Goodbye Bug should now be solved
- More issues Fixed as reported below:

Bugs Fixed:
* Loading Screen Time of Day now Visible.
* Awakening Gains for Captain rebalanced.
* Captain Kill count Check passes at 20 as intended.
* Awakened mode now forced off, on village return.
* AI kill count and Captain Kill count now Reset to Zero at Chapter end.
* Location button now hidden after defeating boss.
* V binding now removed - Zoom out (Debug feature)
* NPC Convo no longer allows multiple menus that cannot be closed (MAJOR)


Tom
Shogunate Games

notes.title: FREE Demo for ANGLES!
notes.content:
Today we have released our Free Demo of Angles!
It features the first Chapter of the Game so you might Try-before-you-Buy. 

It is restricted in Three ways, 
1. There is no Ability to Save your Game.
2. The Game Ends after completing the first Chapter.
3. You only have access to The Forest, Mountains & Dungeon Maps.

Thanks to all the Players who purchased the Full version!
We have already begun adding the content for Chapter 2, 
so watch out for more News right here!


Tom
Shogunate Games
